rules.condition: A required contract layer, stable reference, path chain, authorship identity, or closed schema field is missing or invalid.
A concept exceeds its scope occurrence budget without an allowed exception.
A surface has no single accepted main subject or contains an ownerless non-navigation region.
A derived path-cost dimension exceeds the accepted Journey budget.
A required visible state, recovery edge, preservation guarantee, or authoritative readback is missing.
An action representation, adapter, confirmation policy, mutation, risk, option shape, or equivalent-surface form violates its contract.
A semantic role, representation, state, region, or platform adapter is absent from the canonical UI Grammar.
A required evidence cell has no exact current-source and artifact-digest-bound match.
The candidate reachable Journey inserts, removes, reorders, or changes a required state or action from the accepted trace.
